set.approach: Drive to Adams Lake in the Flat Tops, settle at a campsite, then stroll round to the lake's southwest shore, where the easily reached cliff bands hold the climbs. The route climbs easy ground to a roof, then finishes on slabby terrain.

review.notes: Approach from the area page; route character from the route page. Anchor is a tree on top; no descent stated.

set.approach: Drive to Adams Lake in the Flat Tops, settle at a campsite, then stroll round to the lake's southwest shore, where the easily reached cliff bands hold the climbs. The route starts just right of a tree that stands about two thirds of the way up the cliff, and goes left then back right to avoid the overhang.
